answer: Problem: cloned botnets spin up disposable graders that flood panels before honest raters finish. Mechanism: each seat claim plants a cedar-rooted nullifier committing a jade burn onto a public orchard of three tip parents from distinct prior epochs, locking 1.8 POA until grades finalize. Cost: ~42 min tip gathering plus the bond. Verification: peers recompute the nullifier offline and drop claims with tip-set overlap >1 vs any prior vault seat or a missing unlock height. Failure: mismatched nullifier slashes half the bond and bars that vault from panels for two epochs.
